title: TypeScript provider source reference
description: One ref of the result, mirrored from the ref the provider builds and from the validation that admits it.

sourceContract.authority: bend2/context/typescript/lib/protocol.mjs (validateResult :265-277); the ref is built by lib/refs.mjs:16-23 and deduplicated by lib/query.mjs:99-105
sourceContract.drift: validateResult is the authority for admission and refs.mjs is the authority for the members a ref carries; this document is their admitted mirror, so a change to either requires a change here. A ref names a supported subject selector and the projections admitted for it (:2-4), its id is the canonical JSON array of that selector's fields and is opaque to a consumer, and its snapshot identity is the one in use (:271-277).
sourceContract.identityNote: no $id is set: the admitted identity is a hole for package admission to fill, named by the inventory it admits.

crossFieldRules.detail: an id repeated inside refs refuses with result-ref-ids-not-unique; the builder keeps the first occurrence of an id and drops a later repeat
snapshotId equals the snapshot identity of the result that carries the ref
the id is the canonical JSON array of the selector fields and carries no meaning a consumer may read
